definitions.gloss: state guest, guest of the state
definitions.explanation: A foreign head of state or equivalent dignitary who is officially invited and received with the highest level of protocol and ceremony. In Japan, state guests are formally received by the Emperor and given the most ceremonial treatment.

examples.japanese: {大統領|だいとうりょう}が{国賓|こくひん}として{来日|らいにち}する。
examples.english: The president will visit Japan as a state guest.

examples.japanese: {国賓|こくひん}を{迎|むか}えるための{晩餐会|ばんさんかい}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: A state dinner was held to welcome the state guest.

examples.japanese: {国賓|こくひん}としての{訪問|ほうもん}は{両国|りょうこく}の{外交|がいこう}{関係|かんけい}において{最|もっと}も{格式|かくしき}の{高|たか}いものとされている。
examples.english: A visit as a state guest is considered the most formal level of diplomatic relations between the two countries.

notes:
USAGE:
{国賓|こくひん} is the highest category of foreign guest reception in Japanese diplomacy. It is distinct from {公賓|こうひん} (official guest) and {公式|こうしき}{実務|じつむ}{訪問|ほうもん}{賓客|ひんきゃく} (official working visit guest), which are lower levels of protocol.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国賓|こくひん}として{招|まね}く: to invite as a state guest
- {国賓|こくひん}として{来日|らいにち}する: to visit Japan as a state guest
- {国賓|こくひん}を{迎|むか}える: to receive a state guest
- {国賓|こくひん}{待遇|たいぐう}: state guest treatment
